frozen_target.definition: One complete selected unmarked physical pullback tensor in the original fixed material atlas, exact chart/geometry formulas and recorded physical polynomial coefficients. Same top marker graph metric on its fixed domain; no per-radius re-fit, no Haar quadrature or target interpolation.
frozen_target.open_cost: A full-group invariance of the frozen source is not presumed. Fixed refinement charges both its base tensor mismatch and the actual material Lie derivative of the candidate metric for finite-time control.

complete_small_json.scope: Whole physical chart grids in both symmetry halves, full ends and caps; global material field, target, support and curvature. All extrema and finite-time bounds evaluated here are sampled, not rigorous. No success claim follows from a small training objective.
